name: weapon_workshop
purpose_es: Taller de armas como en Arma Reforger. Parametro de lobby VIOC_WEAPON_WORKSHOP (0 = No, 1 = Si, por defecto). 1) Nueva accion 'TALLER: Accesorios de armas' (mismo lugar y condicion que 'MENU: Equipment': cuartel, camion de municion, FOB o campamento/deposito; vuelve tras reaparecer) y boton 'Taller de armas' en el pie del menu de equipo. Abre el Arsenal de BI con la vista 3D de tu soldado y su arma, limitado a TUS armas (no se pueden cambiar) y a los accesorios que vende tu tienda (nivel de Gear respetado): las pestanas de mira, boca, lateral y bipode solo muestran lo que le queda al arma elegida. Arriba, un cartel muestra en vivo el costo de los cambios y tus fondos, con un boton 'Cancelar (sin cambios)'; mientras estas en el taller eres invulnerable. Al salir (Esc) se vuelve exactamente al equipo de antes y solo se aplican los accesorios validados (compatibles y de la tienda, de tu inventario o quitados en la misma visita); se cobra el precio de tienda de cada accesorio NUEVO (lo que ya estaba montado no cuesta). Si no te alcanza, se deshace todo y te dice el costo. Los accesorios que quitas van a tu inventario si caben (si no, se pierden; te avisa). Aviso final con lo montado y el costo. 2) En el menu de equipo, la pestana de accesorios solo lista los compatibles con el arma principal, el lanzador y la pistola de la unidad que editas, agrupados (miras, bocas, laterales, bipodes) y por nombre; se rehace al cambiar de arma, unidad, plantilla, Clear o Reload. Sin armas (o editando un vehiculo) muestra la lista completa de siempre. Precios y niveles iguales.
source: work/vio_workshop (2026-10-13): VIOC_weapon_workshop.sqf, generador make_patch.py, comprobaciones tools/anchors.py, dryrun.py, lint.py; fuentes de BIS leidas del juego (solo lectura) en work/vio_workshop/bi (fn_arsenal.sqf 2.22, RscDisplayArsenal.sqf, fn_addVirtualItemCargo, fn_baseWeapon, fn_compatibleItems, scripted EH) y de CBA 3.19 en work/vio_workshop/cba (disposable, optics PIP); KJW Two Primary Weapons en work/vio_workshop/kjw
reviewed: 2026-10-13 (work/vio_workshop): Arsenal API checked against the game's own 2.22 sources (functions_f_bootcamp fn_arsenal.sqf: 'Open' params [fullVersion, cargo, center], non-full mode hides face/voice/insignia and the Arsenal/Garage switch, Init preloads by itself under a loading screen when bis_fnc_arsenal_data is missing, arsenalOpened [display, toggleSpace] at the end of Init, arsenalClosed from Exit on unload, closes itself when the centre dies; fn_addVirtualItemCargo/WeaponCargo with isGlobal=false and initAction=false: local variable, no AmmoboxInit action; scripted EH add/remove/call; BIS_fnc_baseWeapon; BIS_fnc_compatibleItems), CBA 3.19 (cba_optics converts 122 CUP optics to scope-1 '_pip' classes outside the Arsenal and back inside it: classes are normalised through cba_optics_NonPIPOptics; cba_disposable launchers keep no attachments) and KJW Two Primary Weapons. Anchors exactly once in the 14 sources (13 Workshop + Everon port; work/vio_workshop/tools/anchors.py); no other catalog patch touches Client_AddMissionActions.sqf, Functions_UI_GearMenu.sqf or Dialogs.hpp, and 'class SEPERATOR_RESPAWN {' is used by no other patch. Dry-run of the 37 scenarios with a catalog copy (weapon_workshop appended last, work/vio_workshop/dryrun.py): 37/37 without errors, every hook exactly once per stage, the new SQF byte-identical (CRLF), no mixed newlines, the param right before SEPERATOR_RESPAWN, no duplicate Params classes, the action right after MENU: Equipment. sqflint 0.3.2 -e w on the script and on each SQF hook (findIf rewritten to 'select {} find 0' only for the linter): 0 messages; bracket/quote check OK. Offline port of the attachment evaluation fuzzed with 50 000 random cases (work/vio_workshop/tools/fuzz_evaluate.py): items always conserved (snapshot attachments + inventory + bought = final attachments + inventory left + returned), cost = sum of bought prices, only compatible items mounted. Independent adversarial SQF review in two passes: no script errors in normal paths; fixed in this version: dying inside the Arsenal could keep Arsenal-made gear (player now invulnerable during the visit, only if damage was allowed; corpse restored; respawn kit = pre-visit kit), fail-closed restore before evaluating, banner race on globals, display-based watchdog plus a per-visit token guard that reverts the loadout and damage if arsenalClosed never arrives, KJW swap window, weapon in hand after closing, Cancel button. Not tested in game.
risks: Untested in game. (1) The first workshop visit in each mission session runs BIS's Arsenal preload (parses every CfgWeapons/CfgVehicles class of CUP+RHS+CDLC) under a loading screen; on the hosted server this pauses the game for some seconds (estimated 5-30 s on the Mac); later visits open at once. No preload at mission start on purpose (it would add that pause to every mission start). (2) The player is invulnerable (allowDamage false, only if isDamageAllowed was true) only while the workshop is open; damage comes back on close, on abort, or from the guard thread if the Arsenal disappears without arsenalClosed; the mission and the other VIOC scripts never change allowDamage on players. (3) Only weapon attachments are kept: on close the whole loadout returns to the snapshot (setUnitLoadout) and validated attachments are put on top, so Arsenal Random/Load/Import/Ctrl+Shift+R/<Empty>/cargo tabs cannot change or create anything; ammo counts are exactly restored. When the loadout must be re-applied (always with CBA PIP optics such as CUP ACOG/PSO, or after touching other tabs) the weapon in hand may be re-selected with a short animation. (4) Random (Ctrl+R) mounts random sold attachments that are charged on Esc; the banner shows the running cost and the 'Cancelar (sin cambios)' button (or not having the money) reverts everything. (5) Validation order for a new attachment: one removed in the same visit (free), one in the player's uniform/vest/backpack (free, removed from there), otherwise the shop at its shop price and upgrade level; anything else (e.g. a preset weapon's linked item the shop does not sell) is refused and the slot keeps its old attachment. Removed attachments go to the inventory with canAdd/addItem, otherwise they are lost (hint). Removing a built-in (scope 1) attachment puts it in the inventory like any other; it can be re-mounted from the normal inventory screen, not from the Arsenal. (6) Weapons cannot be swapped; the KJW stowed rifle is not editable until switched to (key 4). Disposable launchers have no attachment slots and are restored as they were. (7) Arsenal itself creates and deletes its camera-target agent; the workshop creates no objects; the whitelist lives in a local variable of the player (bis_addVirtualWeaponCargo_cargo) only during the visit, and the arsenalOpened/arsenalClosed handlers exist only during the visit. (8) If the player is killed by a script inside the workshop, the weapon dropped from his hands may keep unpaid attachments (the corpse and the respawn kit are restored). (9) Part B: the gear menu's Accessories tab lists only accessories compatible with the primary, launcher and handgun of the unit being edited (union of the mission's and BIS's compatibility lists, so a rare item may be listed but not droppable onto the weapon slot because the drag highlight uses only the mission's list); to buy accessories for a weapon you do not carry, put that weapon in the loadout first; with no weapons (or a vehicle target) the full list appears. Prices and upgrade filtering are unchanged. (10) cti_gear_lastpurchased is not updated by the workshop: with RESPAWN penalty modes other than 'Start with last Gear' (our default) respawn and the gear menu's Reload ignore workshop attachments (writing it would let carried loot respawn for free).
test_in_game_es: Partida nueva (PERSIST 'Disabled' para no tocar tu partida guardada) de 'CW: EE.UU. vs Rusia (frente)'. En el lobby, al final de la seccion GAMEPLAY (justo antes de 'Respawn'), debe salir 'VIOC: Taller de armas' = 'Si'. 1) En el cuartel (o junto a un camion de municion, FOB o campamento) el menu de acciones muestra, debajo de 'MENU: Equipment', 'TALLER: Accesorios de armas' en amarillo; lejos no sale. 2) Abrelo: la primera vez sale una pantalla de carga de unos segundos; despues ves tu soldado en 3D y arriba el cartel 'TALLER DE ARMAS' con 'Costo de los cambios: $0', tus fondos y el boton 'Cancelar (sin cambios)'. A la izquierda solo esta tu arma; con el fusil elegido, las pestanas de la derecha (mira, boca, lateral, bipode) solo muestran lo que le queda y vende tu tienda. 3) Pon una mira (ACOG o PSO) y un silenciador: el cartel muestra 'Compras: ... ($precio)'. Pulsa Esc: aviso 'Taller de armas: cambios aplicados' con lo montado y el costo; tu dinero baja en esa cifra; mochila, chaleco y cargadores siguen igual y tienes en la mano el arma de antes. 4) Vuelve a entrar, quita la mira (<Vacio> / <Empty>) y sal: no cuesta nada y la mira queda en tu mochila ('Guardado en tu inventario'). Entra otra vez y ponla: 'De tu inventario', gratis, y sale de la mochila. 5) Dentro, pulsa Aleatorio (Random) o quitate el uniforme y luego 'Cancelar (sin cambios)': todo queda como estaba. Repite y sal con Esc: solo quedan los accesorios validos (y pagados); la ropa y los cargadores vuelven. 6) Con poco dinero pon una mira cara: el cartel dice 'NO TE ALCANZA'; al salir, aviso con el costo y el arma queda como estaba. 7) Subido a un vehiculo junto al cuartel: aviso 'bajate del vehiculo'. Sin armas: aviso 'no llevas ningun arma'. 8) MENU: Equipment, pestana de accesorios (icono de la mira): solo accesorios de tu fusil, lanzador y pistola, primero miras, despues bocas, laterales y bipodes; arrastra otro fusil al hueco del arma principal y la lista cambia sola; con 'Clear' (sin armas) vuelve la lista completa. 9) El boton 'Taller de armas' del pie del menu de equipo cierra el menu y abre el taller. 10) Con el parametro en 'No' no hay accion ni boton y la pestana de accesorios muestra la lista completa de antes.
